validation_notes: Processed 11 people from HNFG CSV rows 252-262. Checked 3 local HNFG documents: annual report PDF, annual financial statements PDF, and corporate-governance-code DOCX. Research rounds completed: 11 person-rounds, with two web-search passes for people whose official/local biography was incomplete. Education was not confirmed for Золотарева Светлана Сергеевна and Киреев Михаил Сергеевич; their possible external finance-sector profiles were treated as weak/unlinked and excluded from PersonInfo facts. Weak but identity-linked source used: Cbonds-hosted securities prospectus mirror for older formal disclosure data. Main local conflict: the financial statements directors list omits Коршунова, Золотарева and Киреев, while the annual report explicitly lists all three in the Board at 31.12.2024; annual report was used for target-year board composition. Excluded namesakes: Armenian political/military Гагик Мелконян, actor Paul Richter, service-provider Киреев Михаил Сергеевич, several non-HNFG Svetlana Zolotareva profiles, historical Akop Sarkisyan and S8 Capital Armen Sarkisyan. Search is considered complete because all local HNFG files were checked, official IR and disclosure sources were reviewed, education/career searches and namesake checks were performed, and unsupported facts were left empty rather than inferred. ROUND 2 (2026-07-19, targeted gap-filling pass + GICS + qualification_degree + institution normalization, per the four-part task for this ticker): (1) GICS classification added: sector/industry_group/industry added at company level (Consumer Discretionary / Consumer Discretionary Distribution & Retail (New Name) / Specialty Retail - Henderson is a men's-fashion specialty retail chain, classified by its own retail business rather than any manufacturing/luxury-brand angle) and to every professional_experience entry for all 11 people (CEO + 10 TMT), copied verbatim from gics_taxonomy.json and programmatically verified as exact matches against that file (no invented categories). Two entries required identity-first research before classification could be assigned rather than defaulting to null: Арутюнян's 1989-1990 "СКБ 'Гранит'" role (confirmed via russia-armenia.info as a Soviet defense-industry space-instrument design bureau -> Industrials / Capital Goods / Aerospace & Defense) and Глазов's 2022 "ООО ГВД" role (confirmed via companies.rbc.ru, matching the specific Khimki-registered entity ООО "Гриф-Витязь Д", INN 7743005160, OKVED 69.10 legal activities -> Industrials / Commercial & Professional Services / Professional Services - this generic 3-letter company name required the extra identity-confirmation step to avoid classifying the wrong "ООО ГВД"). (2) qualification_degree added to every education[] entry across all 11 people, using only the 10 allowed values; reasoning documented per person in research_notes/HNFG/*_round_2.md - mainly "Specialist degree" for Soviet/Russian pre-Bologna 5-year "инженер-"/"экономист-"/"юрист"-type engineering, economics and law diplomas (Мелконян, Адамян, Арутюнян education[0], Глазов, Коршунова, Саркисян, Нахапетян education[0]), "MBA" for direct MBA matches (Арутюнян education[1], Рихтер), "Master's degree" for Мороз's pre-Bologna Polish "magister" from Uniwersytet Gdanski (structurally different from the Soviet specialist-diploma system, so reasoned separately), and "Executive education" for Нахапетян's two short non-degree business courses (Американский университет Армении 1992, INSEAD 2008). No degrees[] entries exist in this file for any person (all empty), so nothing to add there. Золотарева and Киреев have no education[] entries (see below), so nothing to classify for them either. (3) institution normalization: every non-null institution string in this file already matched an existing synonym or canonical key in university_names.json - normalized to the canonical key in each case: "ЕрПИ"/"Ереванский политехнический институт"/"Ереванский политехнический институт им. К. Маркса" (Арутюнян, Адамян, Саркисян) all -> "Национальный политехнический университет Армении"; Глазов's long "ГОУ ВПО..." name -> "Финансовый университет при Правительстве Российской Федерации"; Мороз's "Гданьский университет" -> "Uniwersytet Gdanski"; Рихтер's "Академия управления продажами, Вена, Австрия" -> "Sales Management Academy, Vienna, Austria"; Нахапетян's "Американский университет Армении" -> "American University of Armenia"; "Международный институт экономики и права" (Коршунова), "Ереванский государственный университет" and "INSEAD" (Нахапетян) were already exact canonical keys. No institution not yet listed in university_names.json was encountered this round, so new_institutions_found remains an empty list for this ticker. (4) Targeted gap-filling results: Мелконян's CEO education institution (previously null) is now confirmed as "Ереванский политехнический институт" (-> canonical "Национальный политехнический университет Армении") by re-reading the same cbonds prospectus already used in round 1 in full - round 1 had only captured the incomplete duplicate listing under the "Генеральный директор" heading (p. 72, institution omitted) and missed the fuller "Совет директоров" listing for the same person a few pages earlier (p. 65, institution present). Саркисян's flagged pre-2020 career gap is partially closed with a dated 2008 RIA Novosti confirmation of an earlier partner-level Ernst & Young role, added as a new professional_experience entry (start_year left null since the source does not give it, per "do not silently invent dates"). Золотарева and Киреев's education/pre-2024-career gaps remain open after a second, differently-angled search pass each (EGM election-materials documents, HNFG IR-site sitemap, fresh namesake sweeps); for Киреев a new Bloomberg entity-profile lead directly tags a "Mikhail S Kireev" as "Board Member at Henderson Fashion Group PJSC", plausibly the same RFPI/HSE-profile person already found and rejected in round 1 for lacking linkage, but the full Bloomberg page could not be read (HTTP 403) and no second corroborating source was found, so per "prefer null over an unverified guess" this was not committed to the JSON - it is logged in research_notes/HNFG/Киреев Михаил Сергеевич_round_2.md as an open lead for a future round instead. Мороз's pre-2023 career gap also remains open after a Poland/foreign-trade-angled search pass that surfaced only unrelated namesakes. Education "year" gaps for Адамян, Глазов, Коршунова, Мороз, Рихтер and Саркисян were reconfirmed as a structural absence in the only available source (the securities prospectus gives birth year but never graduation year for any director) rather than an under-search - left as null. (5) Tooling note: the general WebSearch tool had exhausted its session-level quota (200/200) before this round began; all web research this round used direct WebFetch calls against Yandex search-result pages (Bing and DuckDuckGo either served irrelevant/localized cached content or a bot-detection CAPTCHA), plus direct pdfplumber parsing of PDFs that WebFetch's own text extraction could not read (WebFetch caches downloaded binary PDFs locally; those cached files were located and parsed with pdfplumber directly instead of relying on WebFetch's built-in text summarization, which fails on compressed PDF streams). No previously confirmed fact was deleted or overwritten this round; all changes are additive (new fields) or explicitly documented corrections of an incomplete round-1 extraction (Мелконян's institution).
